text: This major cultivates and practices the socialist core values, has good ideological quality and moral norms, adapts to the development needs of the local economy and the automotive industry, has a solid basic knowledge, basic theories and methods of economics, international economics and international trade trade, is familiar with the prevailing international economic and trade rules and practices, understands and grasps the operation mechanism and development law of international economy, international trade and trade-related financial services, has strong practical operation ability and certain analytical research ability, and can be in industrial and commercial enterprises, Financial institutions, government departments, etc. are engaged in international trade, banking, investment and financing, administrative management and other work related to the application of professionals.
